s0301.literal: Huai Prefecture's Wuzhi County suffered drought.
s0301.idiomatic: Huai Prefecture's Wuzhi County suffered drought.

s0302.literal: Eighth month, on gengzi day, an edict ordered Hebo to leave five thousand troops to garrison; Bolai was ordered to lead the remainder back.
s0302.idiomatic: Eighth month, on gengzi day, an edict ordered Hebo to leave 5,000 troops to garrison; Bolai was ordered to lead the remainder back.

s0303.literal: On dingwei day Prince Azhiji was ordered that from now on when going hunting he must supply everything himself and not harm the people's strength.
s0303.idiomatic: On dingwei day Prince Azhiji was ordered that from now on when going hunting he must supply everything himself and not harm the people's strength.

s0304.literal: On dingsi day a baleful star appeared at Kui.
s0304.idiomatic: On dingsi day a baleful star appeared at Kui.

s0305.literal: Yangzhou, Huai'an, and Ninghai Prefecture suffered drought; Zhending, Shunde, and Hejian suffered drought and epidemic; Chizhou, Jiankang, Ningguo, and Taiping suffered flooding.
s0305.idiomatic: Yangzhou, Huai'an, and Ninghai Prefecture suffered drought; Zhending, Shunde, and Hejian suffered drought and epidemic; Chizhou, Jiankang, Ningguo, and Taiping suffered flooding.

s0306.literal: Ninth month, on the xinyou new moon, the baleful star again transgressed Kui.
s0306.idiomatic: Ninth month, on the xinyou new moon, the baleful star again transgressed Kui.

s0307.literal: On renxu day Bazhao, Shunyuan, and other places had initially been subordinated to Huguang, then changed to Yunnan; Yunnan garrison troops did not arrive, and many of the old troops stationed there fled; Huguang branch secretariat was again ordered to dispatch troops to replace them.
s0307.idiomatic: On renxu day Bazhao, Shunyuan, and other places had initially been subordinated to Huguang, then changed to Yunnan; Yunnan garrison troops did not arrive, and many of the old troops stationed there fled; Huguang branch secretariat was again ordered to dispatch troops to replace them.

s0308.literal: On jiazi day the Eight Hundred Wives rebelled and raided Cheli; Yeshibu was dispatched to lead troops against them.
s0308.idiomatic: On jiazi day the Eight Hundred Wives rebelled and raided Cheli; Yeshibu was dispatched to lead troops against them.

s0309.literal: On bingyin day an edict ordered relief for households in every prefecture suffering flood, drought, or epidemic, and abolished the registration survey of civilian fields in the Two Huai.
s0309.idiomatic: On bingyin day an edict ordered relief for households in every prefecture suffering flood, drought, or epidemic, and abolished the registration survey of civilian fields in the Two Huai.

s0310.literal: Supernumerary personnel among princes coming to Dadu and palace guards were eliminated.
s0310.idiomatic: Supernumerary personnel among princes coming to Dadu and palace guards were eliminated.

s0311.literal: On dingmao day pingzhang Boyan was ordered to take exclusive charge of distributing clothing and grain to the solitary elderly.
s0311.idiomatic: On dingmao day pingzhang Boyan was ordered to take exclusive charge of distributing clothing and grain to the solitary elderly.

s0312.literal: On renwu day the imperial carriage returned to Dadu.
s0312.idiomatic: On renwu day the imperial carriage returned to Dadu.

s0313.literal: On jichou day sea-transport grain was increased to six hundred fifty thousand shi.
s0313.idiomatic: On jichou day sea-transport grain was increased to 650,000 shi.

s0314.literal: The Nandan Prefecture pacification commission was abolished and the Qingyuan Nandan Xidong and other places military-civilian pacification commission was established.
s0314.idiomatic: The Nandan Prefecture pacification commission was abolished and the Qingyuan Nandan Xidong and other places military-civilian pacification commission was established.

s0315.literal: An edict directed that frontier officials who had been preferentially promoted in rank but pleaded other affairs not to take up office should have their promotions stripped.
s0315.idiomatic: An edict directed that frontier officials who had been preferentially promoted in rank but pleaded other affairs not to take up office should have their promotions stripped.

s0316.literal: The Pingzhu, Liudong, and Ten-Department Cave barbarians all came to surrender; they were ordered granted barbarian official posts.
s0316.idiomatic: The Pingzhu, Liudong, and Ten-Department Cave barbarians all came to surrender; they were ordered granted barbarian official posts.

s0317.literal: Grain was granted to palace guards pasturing horses in outer prefectures, with orders not to rely on the people for food.
s0317.idiomatic: Grain was granted to palace guards pasturing horses in outer prefectures, with orders not to rely on the people for food.

s0318.literal: Goods recovered as stolen property by Jalarghuchi were delivered to the central secretariat.
s0318.idiomatic: Goods recovered as stolen property by Jalarghuchi were delivered to the central secretariat.

s0319.literal: Weihui Route suffered drought and epidemic; Lizhou, Changde, Raozhou, Linjiang, and other routes, Pingyang and Ruian prefectures of Wenzhou, suffered severe flooding; Danyang and Jintan in Zhenjiang suffered drought — grain was issued to relieve them all.
s0319.idiomatic: Weihui Route suffered drought and epidemic; Lizhou, Changde, Raozhou, Linjiang, and other routes, Pingyang and Ruian prefectures of Wenzhou, suffered severe flooding; Danyang and Jintan in Zhenjiang suffered drought — grain was issued to relieve them all.

s0320.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiawu day an edict ordered that all transferred officials fill vacancies for two years.
s0320.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, on jiawu day an edict ordered that all transferred officials fill vacancies for two years.

s0321.literal: On dingyou day there were ceremonies at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0321.idiomatic: On dingyou day there were ceremonies at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0322.literal: On xinchou day Shangdu's annual commercial tax quota was reduced to three thousand ingots.
s0322.idiomatic: On xinchou day Shangdu's annual commercial tax quota was reduced to 3,000 ingots.

s0323.literal: Chen Kongya and others of Wenzhou were executed for seditionist speech.
s0323.idiomatic: Chen Kongya and others of Wenzhou were executed for seditionist speech.

s0324.literal: On guichou day Shaanxi salt-household corvée taxes were remitted and the rice they had been granted was discontinued.
s0324.idiomatic: On guichou day Shaanxi salt-household corvée taxes were remitted and the rice they had been granted was discontinued.

s0325.literal: On yimao day Java sent Shilaban Zhimuda bearing a memorial to submit.
s0325.idiomatic: On yimao day Java sent Shilaban Zhimuda bearing a memorial to submit.

s0326.literal: On wuwu day Venus crossed the sky.
s0326.idiomatic: On wuwu day Venus crossed the sky.

s0327.literal: One Minister of Personnel was added.
s0327.idiomatic: One Minister of Personnel was added.

s0328.literal: Because nineteen relay stations of Do Kham were impoverished, horses, cattle, and sheep were granted in varying amounts.
s0328.idiomatic: Because 19 relay stations of Do Kham were impoverished, horses, cattle, and sheep were granted in varying amounts.

s0329.literal: In Wuwei Prefecture of Luzhou Route the river tide overflowed, washing away dwellings.
s0329.idiomatic: In Wuwei Prefecture of Luzhou Route the river tide overflowed, washing away dwellings.

s0330.literal: Liyang, Hefei, Liang County, and Mengcheng and Huoqiu in Anfeng had no rain from spring through autumn; Yangzhou and Huai'an routes suffered famine; Shaozhou, Nanxiong, Jiande, and Wenzhou all suffered severe flooding — all were relieved.
s0330.idiomatic: Liyang, Hefei, Liang County, and Mengcheng and Huoqiu in Anfeng had no rain from spring through autumn; Yangzhou and Huai'an routes suffered famine; Shaozhou, Nanxiong, Jiande, and Wenzhou all suffered severe flooding — all were relieved.

s0331.literal: Eleventh month, on renxu day powerful families, monks, Taoists, and persons of every appanage were forbidden to seize coal and mining hill sites without authorization.
s0331.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on renxu day powerful families, monks, Taoists, and persons of every appanage were forbidden to seize coal and mining hill sites without authorization.

s0332.literal: Five supervisory offices of Shunde, Zhangde, Guangping, and other routes were abolished; two metropolitan supervisory offices were established, promoted to rank 4a, with four officials each, directly subordinate to the central secretariat Households Ministry.
s0332.idiomatic: Five supervisory offices of Shunde, Zhangde, Guangping, and other routes were abolished; two metropolitan supervisory offices were established, promoted to rank 4a, with four officials each, directly subordinate to the central secretariat Households Ministry.

s0333.literal: Weihui Route supervisory office was subordinated to the Guangping-Zhangde metropolitan supervisory office; Zhending ironworks were subordinated to the Shunde metropolitan supervisory office.
s0333.idiomatic: Weihui Route supervisory office was subordinated to the Guangping-Zhangde metropolitan supervisory office; Zhending ironworks were subordinated to the Shunde metropolitan supervisory office.

s0334.literal: The Baoding Zijing Pass ironworks supervisory office was abolished and its eight hundred households were returned to commoner status.
s0334.idiomatic: The Baoding Zijing Pass ironworks supervisory office was abolished and its 800 households were returned to commoner status.

s0335.literal: On guihai day an edict ordered that from now on field hunting begin in the ninth month.
s0335.idiomatic: On guihai day an edict ordered that from now on field hunting begin in the ninth month.

s0336.literal: King Wang Ju of Goryeo requested retirement, asking that his title be given to his son Chon.
s0336.idiomatic: King Wang Ju of Goryeo requested retirement, asking that his title be given to his son Chon.

s0337.literal: Fujian branch secretariat dispatched men to reconnoiter Ryukyu and captured nearly one hundred persons nearby and returned.
s0337.idiomatic: Fujian branch secretariat dispatched men to reconnoiter Ryukyu and captured nearly 100 persons nearby and returned.

s0338.literal: On wuchen day the horses used for sacrificial victims at the Imperial Ancestral Temple were increased.
s0338.idiomatic: On wuchen day the horses used for sacrificial victims at the Imperial Ancestral Temple were increased.

s0339.literal: On gengwu day Tangut troops were registered and entered the privy council.
s0339.idiomatic: On gengwu day Tangut troops were registered and entered the privy council.

s0340.literal: On xinwei day Yucheng in Caozhou presented an auspicious grain stalk with nine ears on one stem.
s0340.idiomatic: On xinwei day Yucheng in Caozhou presented an auspicious grain stalk with nine ears on one stem.

s0341.literal: On dingchou day an edict made Goryeo crown prince Chon Minister of State with the Palace of the First Rank, left grand councillor of the Eastern Campaign branch secretariat, imperial son-in-law, pillar of state, and king of Goryeo; Wang Ju was further enfeoffed as Prince of Yishou with the merit title Loyalty-proclaiming, Power-assisting, Far-stabilizing, Integrity-preserving Merit Lord, Minister of State with the Palace of the First Rank, Grand Marshal, imperial son-in-law, and pillar of state.
s0341.idiomatic: On dingchou day an edict made Goryeo crown prince Chon Minister of State with the Palace of the First Rank, left grand councillor of the Eastern Campaign branch secretariat, imperial son-in-law, pillar of state, and king of Goryeo; Wang Ju was further enfeoffed as Prince of Yishou with the merit title Loyalty-proclaiming, Power-assisting, Far-stabilizing, Integrity-preserving Merit Lord, Minister of State with the Palace of the First Rank, Grand Marshal, imperial son-in-law, and pillar of state.

s0342.literal: One pacification commissioner for Wusa, Wumeng, and other places was added; Boluohuan was appointed.
s0342.idiomatic: One pacification commissioner for Wusa, Wumeng, and other places was added; Boluohuan was appointed.

s0343.literal: Prince Ulusi Buqa was granted one thousand liang of gold, fifteen thousand liang of silver, and ten thousand ingots of notes.
s0343.idiomatic: Prince Ulusi Buqa was granted 1,000 liang of gold, 15,000 liang of silver, and 10,000 ingots of notes.

s0344.literal: The Datong Route military grain depot was moved to Hongcheng.
s0344.idiomatic: The Datong Route military grain depot was moved to Hongcheng.

s0345.literal: Because Henan branch secretariat's operating expenses were insufficient, Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat was ordered to transport two hundred thousand shi of rice to supply it.
s0345.idiomatic: Because Henan branch secretariat's operating expenses were insufficient, Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat was ordered to transport 200,000 shi of rice to supply it.

s0346.literal: Commander-in-chief Wang Weihe was ordered to garrison-farm at Shazhou and Guazhou with his troops; more than twenty-three thousand two hundred ingots of Zhongtong notes were granted for seed, cattle, and farm implements.
s0346.idiomatic: Commander-in-chief Wang Weihe was ordered to garrison-farm at Shazhou and Guazhou with his troops; more than 23,200 ingots of Zhongtong notes were granted for seed, cattle, and farm implements.

s0347.literal: Dadu Route chief administrator Shadi, guilty of corruption and due for dismissal, the Emperor because he was a former subject specially reduced his punishment and allowed him to remain in office.
s0347.idiomatic: Dadu Route chief administrator Shadi, guilty of corruption and due for dismissal, the Emperor because he was a former subject specially reduced his punishment and allowed him to remain in office.

s0348.literal: Cui Yu said he should not be reappointed; the Emperor said: "You and the central secretariat officials shall warn him; if afterwards he again does so, you will be put to death.
s0348.idiomatic: Cui Yu said he should not be reappointed; the Emperor said, "You and the central secretariat officials shall warn him; if afterwards he again does so, you will be put to death.

s0349.literal: " On wuzi day Venus crossed the sky.
s0349.idiomatic: On wuzi day Venus crossed the sky.

s0350.literal: One Prince of Jin chief secretary and one Director of the Palace Transport Bureau were added.
s0350.idiomatic: One Prince of Jin chief secretary and one Director of the Palace Transport Bureau were added.

s0351.literal: Yaomuhu'er was granted one thousand two hundred fifty liang of gold, fifteen thousand liang of silver, and twelve thousand ingots of notes.
s0351.idiomatic: Yaomuhu'er was granted 1,250 liang of gold, 15,000 liang of silver, and 12,000 ingots of notes.

s0352.literal: Changde Route suffered severe flooding; Changzhou Route and Yixing Prefecture suffered drought — all were relieved.
s0352.idiomatic: Changde Route suffered severe flooding; Changzhou Route and Yixing Prefecture suffered drought — all were relieved.

s0353.literal: Twelfth month, on guisi day Yesudai'er and Yaolehuan were ordered to lead troops on campaign.
s0353.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on guisi day Yesudai'er and Yaolehuan were ordered to lead troops on campaign.

s0354.literal: On bingshen day the Qoraclut garrison-farm troops at Xiangyang were moved to Nanyang; each household received one hundred fifty mu of fields, with seed, cattle, and farm implements supplied.
s0354.idiomatic: On bingshen day the Qoraclut garrison-farm troops at Xiangyang were moved to Nanyang; each household received 150 mu of fields, with seed, cattle, and farm implements supplied.

s0355.literal: On wuxu day central secretariat officials together with Henan pingzhang Boluohuan and others said: "When Shizu pacified Jiangnan, garrison troops of thirty-one wings were established up and down the river; now scarcely one or two remain, and we fear unforeseen events.
s0355.idiomatic: On wuxu day central secretariat officials together with Henan pingzhang Boluohuan and others said, "When Shizu pacified Jiangnan, garrison troops of 31 wings were established up and down the river; now scarcely one or two remain, and we fear unforeseen events.

s0356.literal: For garrison soldiers in outer prefectures, stored pay allotments — military officers delay and do not draw them on time, but lend their own money and charge double interest.
s0356.idiomatic: For garrison soldiers in outer prefectures, stored pay allotments — military officers delay and do not draw them on time, but lend their own money and charge double interest.

s0357.literal: Deserters — garrison officials everywhere and ten-thousand-household offices all dispatch men to pursue and capture — none of this is appropriate.
s0357.idiomatic: Deserters — garrison officials everywhere and ten-thousand-household offices all dispatch men to pursue and capture — none of this is appropriate.

s0358.literal: Furthermore wealthy households evade corvée taxes by posing as monks and Taoists; moreover monks and Taoists trade as merchants and have wives and children no different from registered commoners — we request they be eliminated and made commoners.
s0358.idiomatic: Furthermore wealthy households evade corvée taxes by posing as monks and Taoists; moreover monks and Taoists trade as merchants and have wives and children no different from registered commoners — we request they be eliminated and made commoners.

s0359.literal: In Song times those becoming monks or Taoists had first to pay money to the county authorities before receiving ordination certificates; now there is no fixed regulation, and opportunists will surely be many.
s0359.idiomatic: In Song times those becoming monks or Taoists had first to pay money to the county authorities before receiving ordination certificates; now there is no fixed regulation, and opportunists will surely be many.

s0360.literal: For Wuwei alum tax, initial annual revenue was only one hundred six ingots of notes, but it was continually increased to two thousand four hundred ingots; generally it is made up by levying wealthy households, cutting officials' salaries, and stopping furnace-household production costs — this too should be reduced.
s0360.idiomatic: For Wuwei alum tax, initial annual revenue was only 106 ingots of notes, but it was continually increased to 2,400 ingots; generally it is made up by levying wealthy households, cutting officials' salaries, and stopping furnace-household production costs — this too should be reduced.

s0361.literal: " The Emperor said: "Send men to verify the alum tax; as for the regulation for eliminating monks and Taoists, you shall deliberate and memorialize.
s0361.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Send men to verify the alum tax; as for the regulation for eliminating monks and Taoists, you shall deliberate and memorialize.

s0362.literal: Military affairs shall be deliberated with the privy council.
s0362.idiomatic: Military affairs shall be deliberated with the privy council.

s0363.literal: " Prince Yezhili's subject Huladai at Shanghe County, Jinan, harassed residents and trampled crops; the Emperor ordered him questioned; he fled back to his tribe.
s0363.idiomatic: Prince Yezhili's subject Huladai at Shanghe County, Jinan, harassed residents and trampled crops; the Emperor ordered him questioned; he fled back to his tribe.

s0364.literal: The Emperor said: "He is a kinsman — is there such a principle?
s0364.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "He is a kinsman — is there such a principle?

s0365.literal: Let Yezhili be made to punish him.
s0365.idiomatic: Let Yezhili be made to punish him.

s0366.literal: " Princes, imperial sons-in-law, and powerful families were forbidden to seize commoners' fields; those who presented fields would be punished.
s0366.idiomatic: Princes, imperial sons-in-law, and powerful families were forbidden to seize commoners' fields; those who presented fields would be punished.

s0367.literal: The Shaobo and Hongze garrison farms were re-established.
s0367.idiomatic: The Shaobo and Hongze garrison farms were re-established.

s0368.literal: On renyin day Chaodong barbarians submitted; two native official offices were established and Yang Hanying was ordered to head them.
s0368.idiomatic: On renyin day Chaodong barbarians submitted; two native official offices were established and Yang Hanying was ordered to head them.

s0369.literal: On jiachen day Venus crossed the sky and also transgressed Eastern Sentence.
s0369.idiomatic: On jiachen day Venus crossed the sky and also transgressed Eastern Sentence.

s0370.literal: On bingwu day the moon transgressed Xuanyuan.
s0370.idiomatic: On bingwu day the moon transgressed Xuanyuan.

s0371.literal: On dingwei day chaste widow Wang, wife of Zhang Wenxing, an official of Zhangzhou Recruit-and-Pacify Office, was honored.
s0371.idiomatic: On dingwei day chaste widow Wang, wife of Zhang Wenxing, an official of Zhangzhou Recruit-and-Pacify Office, was honored.

s0372.literal: On wushen day twelve relay vouchers were added for the Yunnan surveillance commission.
s0372.idiomatic: On wushen day 12 relay vouchers were added for the Yunnan surveillance commission.

s0373.literal: On jiayin day the moon transgressed Heart.
s0373.idiomatic: On jiayin day the moon transgressed Heart.

s0374.literal: On yimao day government hire and government purchase were remitted for relay households from Shangdu to Dadu and at Xuande and twelve other stations.
s0374.idiomatic: On yimao day government hire and government purchase were remitted for relay households from Shangdu to Dadu and at Xuande and 12 other stations.

s0375.literal: Prince Hulachu was granted one thousand ingots of notes, and his department forty-four thousand five hundred-odd ingots;
s0375.idiomatic: Prince Hulachu was granted 1,000 ingots of notes, and his department 44,500-odd ingots;

s0376.literal: Princes Asu and Suge Temur's departments twenty-eight thousand nine hundred-odd ingots.
s0376.idiomatic: Princes Asu and Suge Temur's departments 28,900-odd ingots.

s0377.literal: Intercalary twelfth month, on renxu day the moon transgressed Encampment.
s0377.idiomatic: Intercalary twelfth month, on renxu day the moon transgressed Encampment.

s0378.literal: Yesudai'er and others were ordered on campaign;
s0378.idiomatic: Yesudai'er and others were ordered on campaign;

s0379.literal: An edict directed that when military households sold fields, the office they belonged to issue documentary certificates.
s0379.idiomatic: An edict directed that when military households sold fields, the office they belonged to issue documentary certificates.

s0380.literal: On jiazi day Fujian pingzhang Gao Xing said: "Daliang Mountain in Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou, produces crystal; we request one hundred commoner households be assigned to mine it.
s0380.idiomatic: On jiazi day Fujian pingzhang Gao Xing said, "Daliang Mountain in Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou, produces crystal; we request 100 commoner households be assigned to mine it.

s0381.literal: " The Emperor said: "If it does not trouble the people it may be done; if it troubles the people, do not take it.
s0381.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "If it does not trouble the people it may be done; if it troubles the people, do not take it.

s0382.literal: " On renshen day Nayan's subject households were moved to the interior.
s0382.idiomatic: On renshen day Nayan's subject households were moved to the interior.

s0383.literal: Corvée taxes for households under Yantuhusi were fixed: one-third paid to the government.
s0383.idiomatic: Corvée taxes for households under Yantuhusi were fixed: one-third paid to the government.

s0384.literal: Hulachu's department was granted ten thousand ingots of notes.
s0384.idiomatic: Hulachu's department was granted 10,000 ingots of notes.

s0385.literal: From guiyou to bingzi Venus transgressed Establishment.
s0385.idiomatic: From guiyou to bingzi Venus transgressed Establishment.

s0386.literal: On jimao day qianhu of Busitabo and others were granted about ninety thousand ingots of notes.
s0386.idiomatic: On jimao day qianhu of Busitabo and others were granted about 90,000 ingots of notes.

s0387.literal: Huaidong suffered famine; Secretariat Affairs Participant Yu Zhang was dispatched to open granaries and relieve; prohibition on lakes was relaxed, and first-month hunting was permitted.
s0387.idiomatic: Huaidong suffered famine; secretariat affairs participant Yu Zhang was dispatched to open granaries and relieve; prohibition on lakes was relaxed, and first-month hunting was permitted.

s0388.literal: Pingfa and other barbarians had not submitted; Bozhou Pacification Commissioner Yang Hanying requested to suppress them with his own forces; Huguang Province Darqan was ordered to receive and pacify as appropriate.
s0388.idiomatic: Pingfa and other barbarians had not submitted; Bozhou pacification commissioner Yang Hanying requested to suppress them with his own forces; Huguang Province darqan was ordered to receive and pacify as appropriate.

s0389.literal: Ten thousand Guazhou garrison-farm troops were impoverished; an order reduced them by one thousand, supplemented by troops under Zhang wanhu.
s0389.idiomatic: 10,000 Guazhou garrison-farm troops were impoverished; an order reduced them by 1,000, supplemented by troops under Zhang wanhu.

s0390.literal: On jiashen day Two Huai garrison-farm troops were increased to twenty thousand men.
s0390.idiomatic: On jiashen day Two Huai garrison-farm troops were increased to 20,000 men.

s0391.literal: Prince Ayachi was granted one thousand ingots of notes, his department eleven thousand-odd ingots; Yaolehuan's department seventy thousand ingots; Andulahuo's department forty thousand-odd ingots.
s0391.idiomatic: Prince Ayachi was granted 1,000 ingots of notes, his department 11,000-odd ingots; Yaolehuan's department 70,000 ingots; Andulahuo's department 40,000-odd ingots.

s0392.literal: Anyang Route suffered famine and epidemic; two months' grain was issued.
s0392.idiomatic: Anyang Route suffered famine and epidemic; two months' grain was issued.

s0393.literal: That year Jinan and Jin and Fu prefectures suffered flood and drought; Tanshou and Shunzhou in Dadu; Liaoyang, Shenyang, and Guangning suffered flooding; Shunde, Hejian, Daming, and Pingyang suffered drought.
s0393.idiomatic: That year Jinan and Jin and Fu prefectures suffered flood and drought; Tanshou and Shunzhou in Dadu; Liaoyang, Shenyang, and Guangning suffered flooding; Shunde, Hejian, Daming, and Pingyang suffered drought.

s0394.literal: In Hejian's Leshou and Jiaohe an epidemic killed more than six thousand five hundred persons.
s0394.idiomatic: In Hejian's Leshou and Jiaohe an epidemic killed more than 6,500 persons.

s0395.literal: One hundred seventy-five persons were sentenced to death.

s0396.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, on renchen day an edict ordered that because of flood and drought prefectural and county land taxes be reduced by three-tenths, those severely harmed fully remitted, and corvée taxes for the aged, ill, solitary, and weak remitted for three years.
s0396.idiomatic: In the second year, spring, first month, on renchen day an edict ordered that because of flood and drought prefectural and county land taxes be reduced by three-tenths, those severely harmed fully remitted, and corvée taxes for the aged, ill, solitary, and weak remitted for three years.

s0397.literal: Princes, princesses, and imperial sons-in-law were forbidden to accept land presented by others or privately recruit households.
s0397.idiomatic: Princes, princesses, and imperial sons-in-law were forbidden to accept land presented by others or privately recruit households.

s0398.literal: On bingshen day envoys were dispatched to inspect troops in every province.
s0398.idiomatic: On bingshen day envoys were dispatched to inspect troops in every province.

s0399.literal: On dingyou day Tingzhou garrison farming was established.
s0399.idiomatic: On dingyou day Tingzhou garrison farming was established.

s0400.literal: On xinchou day censorate officials said: "For transport commission case documents, by regulation year-end inspection and verification is required.
s0400.idiomatic: On xinchou day censorate officials said, "For transport commission case documents, by regulation year-end inspection and verification is required.
